clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore, Gelkak Gyromast seeks payback from the murlocs who plundered his wrecked ship. He sends you to reactivate his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100.

Gelkak Gyromast is stranded on Darkshore, but he will not accept defeat by the shore-dwelling murlocs. He has salvaged the pieces needed for his scheme and now seeks revenge on the tribe and its chief. Rather than take up his cutlass and wade into the surf, the eccentric captain turns to engineering. He entrusts you with a winding key and asks you to handle his mechanical subordinate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Landlubber, ye needs to find me first mate.
Take this'n key, puts it in his gulliver an' bring him back here to serve the Cap'n.
Them murlocs an' their chief ain't gonna be too happy once me first mate gets a hold of em!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Where be me first mate, friend? Shackles n' sharks fer ye soon if ye don't hurry!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yarrr... Ye be provin' yerself to be more than a yella sea dog, landlubber.
The Cap'n may promote ye to poop deck swabby if ye be keepin' this up...
